measurements.system_model: BALB/c mice, normal (non-challenged); platelet poor plasma collected 5 days after the last dose
measurements.dose_unit: mg/kg per dose (twice weekly for 3 weeks)
measurements.control_description: PBS-treated group dosed on the same schedule. The patent defines the tabulated value as the treated/PBS ratio raised to the ISI power, so the PBS reference is 1.00 by construction but is not printed in the table.
measurements.effect_vs_control: As shown in Table 4, PT was not significantly prolonged in mice treated with ISIS 410944 or ISIS 410975. However, aPTT was prolonged in a dose-dependent manner in mice treated with ISIS 410944.
measurements.source_locus: Table 4 “Effect of ISIS 410944 and ISIS 410975 on PT and aPTT in BALB/c mice”, row ISIS 410944 / 5 mg/kg, column “PT INR”
measurements.notes: ON-TARGET anticoagulant pharmacology of a Factor 12 gapmer. ISIS 410975 is the built-in negative comparator: same chemistry, same target gene, same dose range, aPTT flat at 0.97-1.02 across 5-50 mg/kg while ISIS 410944 rises monotonically to 1.20. Granted claims 5 and 7 of this patent recite aPTT prolongation, so the compound-to-readout attribution is legally explicit. Values are INR; no absolute clotting time in seconds is published anywhere in this patent. The PT null is a MEASURED NULL, stated in the text quoted in effect_vs_control.

measurements.system_model: BALB/c mice; Factor 12 proenzyme measured by a Factor 12-deficient-plasma clotting-time assay on an ST4 semi-automated coagulation instrument
measurements.dose_unit: mg/kg per dose (twice weekly for 3 weeks)
measurements.control_description: PBS control; results expressed as percent inhibition relative to PBS control
measurements.effect_vs_control: As shown in Table 5, treatment with ISIS 410944 resulted in a significant dose-dependent reduction of Factor 12 protein.
measurements.source_locus: Table 5 “Dose-dependent inhibition of murine Factor 12 protein by ISIS 410944 in BALB/c mice”, row 5 mg/kg
measurements.notes: Value is PERCENT INHIBITION of Factor 12 proenzyme, i.e. a decrease, not a percent-of-control activity. The assay is clotting-time based (Factor 12-deficient plasma plus aPTT reagent), which is why it is filed here as a coagulation factor-activity readout rather than as a protein ELISA. 61/74/90/96% inhibition at 5/10/25/50 mg/kg tracks the aPTT rise in Table 4 for the same animals.

measurements.system_model: FeCl3-induced venous (vena cava) thrombosis model in BALB/c mice; thrombus platelet content quantified by real-time PCR for platelet factor-4 (PF-4)
measurements.dose_unit: mg/kg per dose (twice weekly for 3 weeks)
measurements.timepoint: 2 days after the last dose; vein harvested 30 min after FeCl3 application
measurements.n_subjects: 8 per treatment group; 12 per PBS control group
measurements.control_description: PBS + FeCl3 control set to 100; PBS − FeCl3 (no thrombus) reference set to 0
measurements.effect_vs_control: As shown in Table 12, treatment with ISIS 410944 resulted in a dose-dependent reduction of PF-4 in comparison to the PBS control.
measurements.source_locus: Table 12 “Analysis of thrombus formation by real-time PCR quantification of PF-4 in the FeCl 3 induced venous thrombosis model”, row ISIS 410944 / 1.25 mg/kg
measurements.notes: PLATELET-DERIVED MARKER USED AS A THROMBUS MASS READOUT, NOT A PLATELET COUNT. PF-4 mRNA in the excised vein indexes platelet incorporation into the clot; the source ties it explicitly to Factor 12 knockdown and to clot formation, which is why it is filed here as a thrombotic outcome. It is not a thrombocytopenia row.

measurements.notes: PLATELET READOUT INCLUDED ONLY BECAUSE IT IS AN IN VIVO THROMBUS-FORMATION MEASURE TIED TO FACTOR 12 KNOCKDOWN - IT IS NOT A PLATELET COUNT AND NOT A THROMBOCYTOPENIA ROW. measurements.source_locus: Table 22 “Activated Partial Thromboplastin Time (sec) in cynomolgus macaque (Macaca fascicularis) primates following administration of 2 mg/kg AD01001 with 2 mg/kg MLP delivery polymer”, row animal 1, column pre-dose
measurements.notes: PER-INDIVIDUAL-ANIMAL aPTT IN ABSOLUTE SECONDS - the only such table in this bundle; every other aPTT row here is a pooled INR or ratio. Both animals received the same single 2 mg/kg dose, so the two series are biological replicates, not a dose response. The row is keyed to the antisense strand S8_AD01001_AS; the dosed article is the AD01001 duplex (AM01629-AS + AM01617-SS) co-injected with MLP delivery polymer, i.e. a POLYMER-FORMULATED duplex, not naked oligonucleotide. Peaks (48.6 s animal 1 day 15; 47.4 s animal 2 day 29) sit ~50-60% above each animal’s own pre-dose value, consistent with the text. PT was measured in the same study and reported unchanged.

measurements.system_model: Plasma from BALB/c mice dosed in vivo with ISIS 404071, then spiked EX VIVO with the low-molecular-weight heparin LOVENOX (enoxaparin); PT/aPTT read 20 minutes after the spike
measurements.delivery_method: ISIS 404071 given subcutaneously in vivo; no LOVENOX added to this condition
measurements.dose_value: ISIS 404071 10 mg/kg in vivo + LOVENOX 0 (units as printed in the table header)
measurements.dose_unit: mg/kg (ASO, per dose twice weekly for 3 weeks) + mg/ml per the table header / μg/ml per the body text (LOVENOX)
measurements.timepoint: 20 minutes after LOVENOX addition; plasma collected 5 days after the last ASO dose
measurements.control_description: matched LOVENOX concentration in plasma from mice that received no ISIS 404071 (the “0 mg/kg” row of the same table)
measurements.effect_vs_control: As shown in Table 27, treatment with LOVENOX increases PT in a dose-dependent manner. Treatment with ISIS 404071 does not significantly increase PT. ... There is no evidence of a combinational effect on PT in ISIS 404071 and LOVENOX treated plasma.
measurements.source_locus: Table 27, row ISIS 404071 10 mg/kg, column LOVENOX 0
measurements.notes: ASO-ALONE ARM (LOVENOX concentration 0). aPTT reaches INR 4.78 for 40 mg/kg ISIS 404071 plus the top LOVENOX concentration, against 1.52 for the ASO alone and 2.70 for LOVENOX alone; the source itself calls this synergistic. UNIT CONTRADICTION IN THE SOURCE: the body text states LOVENOX was added to the plasma ex vivo at 0, 2.5, 5.0 and 7.5 μg/ml, but the Table 27 and Table 28 column headers read “LOVENOX (mg/ml)”. The concentrations are recorded here exactly as the table header prints them and the contradiction is left unresolved; a 1000-fold unit error would change the interpretation completely. The 40 mg/kg / 5.0 aPTT cell is printed as “n.d. = no data” and was not emitted as a row. STUDY-TYPE NOTE: oligonucleotide exposure was in vivo in mice and the heparin exposure was a spike into the collected murine plasma, so this is a hybrid design; study_type is recorded as animal_invivo because the schema's only ex vivo term is ex_vivo_HUMAN_plasma and this plasma is murine.

measurements.system_model: FeCl3-induced mesenteric vein thrombosis in C57BL/6 mice with intravital microscopy of calcein-labelled platelets; time to first 30-50 μm thrombus
measurements.delivery_method: subcutaneous injection twice a week for three weeks
measurements.dose_unit: mg/kg per dose (twice weekly for 3 weeks)
measurements.timepoint: two days after the last injection
measurements.control_description: control-oligonucleotide arm (ISIS 405277, an antisense oligonucleotide against Factor 2/prothrombin)
measurements.effect_vs_control: Thrombus formation (30 μm in diameter) occurred in mice treated with ISIS 404071 at 14.8±1.7 minutes. Thrombus formation (30 μm in diameter) occurred in control mice at 8.9±0.6 minutes. Occlusive thrombi formed in control mice at 19.3±0.8 min and all injured venules occluded. In contrast, the majority of the veins in ISIS 404071 treated mice did not occlude when observation was terminated 40 minutes after injury and those veins showing occlusion. The only vein showing occlusion in the ISIS 404071 treated mice occluded at 29.5 minutes and reopened after 5 minutes, prior to the end of the study.

measurements.notes: COMPARATOR HAZARD - THE "CONTROL" IS ITSELF AN ANTICOAGULANT. The control arm of Example 22 is ISIS 405277, which the patent describes as "a control oligonucleotide" but also identifies as an "antisense oligonucleotide for Factor 2", i.e. against prothrombin. A time-to-thrombosis comparison against a prothrombin ASO is a comparison against a second anticoagulant, not against an inert oligonucleotide, and if the control arm is itself antithrombotic the ISIS 404071 effect is understated. This is the single most important interpretive caveat in Example 22 and the patent does not acknowledge it. Values are mean ± SD in minutes as printed; no group size is given.

This is the single most important interpretive caveat in Example 22 and the patent does not acknowledge it. Values are mean ± SD in minutes as printed; no group size is given.

measurements.control_description: PBS group dosed on the same schedule; the tabulated value is the treated/PBS ratio raised to the ISI power, so the PBS reference is 1.00 by construction and is not printed
measurements.effect_vs_control: However, aPTT was prolonged in a dose-dependent manner, as presented in Table 117. These data suggest that antisense reduction of Factor 11 affects the contact activation pathway, but not the extrinsic pathway of blood coagulation.
measurements.source_locus: Table 117 “Effect of ISIS antisense oligonucleotides on aPTT ratio in cynomolgus monkeys”, row day 78, column ISIS 416864
measurements.notes: PRIMARY ON-TARGET ANTICOAGULATION SIGNAL IN NON-HUMAN PRIMATES. The two potent compounds separate clearly from the rest: ISIS 416850 reaches aPTT ratio 1.99 and ISIS 416858 reaches 1.79 by day 85, while ISIS 416838, ISIS 416864 and ISIS 417002 plateau at 1.15-1.25 despite the identical escalating dose regimen - so the effect tracks compound potency (see the matched Factor 11 activity inhibition in Table 118), not simply phosphorothioate exposure. ISIS 416858 is the sequence later developed as IONIS-FXIRx/fesomersen. Values are ratios to the PBS group.

measurements.notes: Value is PERCENT INHIBITION of Factor 11 ACTIVITY (a decrease), measured by a Factor 11-deficient-plasma clotting-time assay on an ST4 instrument, which is why it is filed as a coagulation factor-activity readout even though the table caption says “protein”. measurements.source_locus: Table 119 “Effect of ISIS antisense oligonucleotides on fibrinogen levels in cynomolgus monkeys”, row day −14, column ISIS 416838
measurements.notes: FIBRINOGEN WAS MEASURED BUT THE PATENT DRAWS NO CONCLUSION FROM IT - the text introduces Table 119 and says nothing further, so effect_direction is NOT_REPORTED rather than no_change: this is reported-but-uninterpreted, not a stated null. Reading the numbers, the ISIS 416850 escalating arm drifts from 310 mg/dL pre-dose to 177-190 mg/dL by days 71-85 while the PBS group holds at 233-246 mg/dL over the same window, a roughly 25-40 percent divergence that the patent never mentions. A fibrinogen fall in an anticoagulant programme is exactly the kind of signal this dossier exists to capture, so this table should be reviewed rather than taken at the source's (silent) word.

measurements.verbatim_quote: Changes in Factor 11 protein levels are also measured using a thrombin generation assay. In addition, effects on clot times, e.g. PT and aPTT, are determined using plasma from treated animals.
measurements.notes: REPORTING SILENCE, NOT A MEASURED NULL. US 10,772,906 B2 states in its general description that Factor 11 protein changes “are also measured using a thrombin generation assay”, but no thrombin generation result appears in any of its 169 tables or in any example. measurements.verbatim_quote: In certain embodiments, administration of an antisense compound targeted to a Factor 12 nucleic acid results in a change in a measure of blood clotting as measured by a standard test, for example, but not limited to, activated partial thromboplastin time (aPTT) test, prothrombin time (PT) test, thrombin time (TCT), bleeding time, or D-dimer.
measurements.notes: REPORTING SILENCE, NOT A MEASURED NULL. Thrombin time (TCT) and D-dimer are named as contemplated endpoints in US 9,150,864 B2 but neither is measured or reported. No fibrinogen measurement appears anywhere in this patent either - the only fibrinogen-related datum is the anti-fibrinogen antibody used to image fibrin in Table 21. effect_direction is NOT_REPORTED (never no_change), because the source never measured this endpoint; this row must not be counted as evidence of absence of an effect.

measurements.verbatim_quote: At the indicated time points (indicated in Tables 21-23), blood samples were drawn and analyzed for F12 levels, coagulation parameters and toxicity markers.
measurements.notes: REPORTING SILENCE. US 10,858,658 B2 states that “coagulation parameters” were analysed at every timepoint but reports only aPTT (Table 22) and a qualitative PT null. The words fibrinogen, D-dimer, thrombin generation, antithrombin and thrombin time appear nowhere in the patent (the only “thrombin time” matches are inside “thromboplastin time”). The coagulation panel behind “coagulation parameters” is therefore undisclosed. effect_direction is NOT_REPORTED (never no_change), because the source never measured this endpoint; this row must not be counted as evidence of absence of an effect.

measurements.system_model: BALB/c mice, Example 3 in vivo study; plasma was collected for clotting analysis but no PT or aPTT value is published for this compound
measurements.dose_unit: mg/kg per dose (twice weekly for 3 weeks)
measurements.control_description: PBS-treated group dosed on the same schedule
measurements.effect_vs_control: NOT_REPORTED
measurements.source_locus: Example 3 “Treatment” paragraph (the study that produced Tables 3, 4 and 5); no corresponding row exists in Table 4
measurements.verbatim_quote: BALB/c mice were injected with 5 mg/kg, 10 mg/kg, 25 mg/kg, or 50 mg/kg of ISIS 410944, ISIS 410973, ISIS 410974, or ISIS 410975, administered subcutaneously twice a week for 3 weeks. A control group of mice was injected with phosphate buffered saline (PBS), administered subcutaneously twice a week for 3 weeks. Mice were sacrificed 5 days after receiving the last dose. Whole liver was harvested for RNA analysis and plasma was collected for clotting analysis (PT and aPTT) and protein analysis.
measurements.notes: REPORTING SILENCE WITH EVIDENCE OF COLLECTION, NOT A MEASURED NULL. Four compounds were dosed in this study and the text states plasma was collected from all of them for PT and aPTT, but Table 4 publishes clotting results for only two - ISIS 410944 and ISIS 410975. ISIS 410973 and ISIS 410974 have mRNA knockdown data (Table 3) and dosing but no published clotting time, so the selective-reporting gap is real and demonstrable from the patent's own text. effect_direction is NOT_REPORTED and this row must not be counted as evidence that no effect occurred.

modifications.basis: Uniform gapmer design published for every oligonucleotide in Table 1 of US 9,150,864 B2: “The chimeric antisense oligonucleotides in Table 1 were designed as 5-10-5 MOE gapmers. The gapmers are 20 nucleotides in length, wherein the central gap segment is comprised of ten 2′-deoxynucleosides and is flanked on both sides (in the 5′ and 3′ directions) by wings comprising 5 nucleosides each. Each nucleoside in the 5′ wing segment and each nucleoside in the 3′ wing segment has a 2′-MOE modification. The internucleoside linkages throughout each gapmer are phosphorothioate (P═S) linkages. All cytosine residues throughout each gapmer are 5-methylcytosines.” Nucleobase taken from the printed sequence.

extraction_notes:
SCOPE AND WHAT THIS BUNDLE IS
Three issued US patents covering deliberate, ON-TARGET pharmacological anticoagulation by oligonucleotides directed at
contact-pathway coagulation factors: Ionis/Isis Factor XI (US 10,772,906 B2), Isis Factor XII (US 9,150,864 B2) and
Arrowhead Factor XII RNAi (US 10,858,658 B2). Almost every row here is intended pharmacology, not unintended toxicity; the
on_target_effect and unintended_toxicity flags are set independently and both can be true on one row.

FLAGGING RULES APPLIED CONSISTENTLY (stated so a reviewer can re-derive them)
- on_target_effect = true whenever the readout follows from knockdown of the intended coagulation factor. It is false only for
  the mismatch control ISIS 421208, for the Factor 2 (prothrombin) ASO ISIS 405277 when it is acting as the comparator arm,
  for the unnamed Arrowhead F7 trigger, and for reporting-silence rows.
- unintended_toxicity = true only on rows whose readout is a bleeding or haemorrhage measure (tail bleeding, template bleeding
  time, intracerebral haemorrhage volume/deficit/mortality), plus the ISIS 404071 + warfarin combination clotting-time rows where
  PT INR exceeds 20. Clotting-time prolongation by design is not flagged as toxicity.
- effect_direction = "no_change" is used ONLY where the source states a measured null in its own words; that sentence is copied
  into effect_vs_control on every such row. Where an endpoint is never measured, effect_direction is NOT_REPORTED and the row is
  labelled REPORTING SILENCE in notes.

TABLE-ROW VERBATIM CONVENTION
The USPTO HTML-to-text conversion puts every table CELL on its own physical line, so a printed table row cannot be copied as a
contiguous run of source text. For every table-derived measurement, verbatim_quote is the printed table row reconstructed by
joining its cells with single spaces in printed left-to-right order, and source_locus names the table, the row and the column so
the cell can be located exactly. Prose-derived rows carry the sentence copied verbatim.

NO FIGURE READING
Nothing was read off a plotted panel. Where a value exists only in a figure - Arrowhead FIG. 5/6/7 (aPTT time courses), FIG. 10
(time to carotid occlusion) and FIG. 11 (bleeding times, including the F7 positive control) - readout_value is NOT_REPORTED and
readout_is_qualitative is true.

CONTRADICTIONS AND HAZARDS FOUND IN THE SOURCES (each is also repeated in the notes of the affected rows)
1. US 10,772,906 Table 43: the table carries its own footnote "*values in Table 43 are approximate", and the accompanying prose
   states aPTT showed a "progressive decrease ... until day 4 and then progressive increase", whereas the printed values do the
   opposite (1.02 -> 1.30 by day 4, then back to 1.02 by day 28). The 12-hour and day-56 cells are printed as "0", an impossible
   aPTT INR that almost certainly marks a missing measurement. Values recorded exactly as printed.
2. US 10,772,906 Tables 37-39 (collagenase intracerebral haemorrhage): the patent asserts ISIS 404071 "did not have a significant
   effect on the hemorrhagic size, neurologic deficit score, or mortality", yet prints a neurologic deficit score of 3.8 for
   ISIS 404071 against 2.4 for PBS and 2.0 for the mismatch control, and 20% mortality against 0% for both controls. The warfarin
   cohort described in the Example 25 text appears only in the mortality table, not in Tables 37 or 38. No group sizes, dispersion
   or statistics are given anywhere in these three tables.
3. US 10,772,906 Tables 27/28: the body text gives the ex vivo LOVENOX concentrations as 0, 2.5, 5.0 and 7.5 ug/ml while both
   table headers read "LOVENOX (mg/ml)" - a 1000-fold unit conflict left unresolved. Concentrations recorded as the header prints them.
4. US 10,772,906 Tables 25/26: the Example 14/15 body text lists ISIS 404071 doses of 1.25-40 mg/kg and Apixaban doses of
   0.5-5 mg/kg, but the tables print ISIS doses up to 50 mg/kg and Apixaban doses up to 20 mg/kg. Table doses are recorded.
   The Example 15 heading text also says the assay compared "ISIS 404071 or warfarin" when the comparator was Apixaban.
5. US 10,772,906 Tables 148/149: the introductory sentence says PT and aPTT were measured "from mice", but Example 46 and both
   captions describe a cynomolgus monkey study. Species recorded as monkey per the example design and captions.
6. US 10,772,906 Table 23 is referred to as "Table 16" in its own preamble.
7. US 10,772,906 Table 40: the un-thrombosed PBS - FeCl3 reference is printed as 29 rather than 0 as in the sibling PF-4 tables,
   compressing the dynamic range; the ISIS 404071 + FeCl3 value of 40 sits close to that floor.
8. US 10,772,906 Table 41: the patent claims the PLAVIX combination gives "no increased bleeding risk", but at 12.50 mg/kg PLAVIX
   the combination lost 0.300 g against 0.205 g for PLAVIX alone. Table 30 has the same shape of problem for LOVENOX at 45 and
   60 mg/kg.
9. US 10,772,906 Example 22: the "control oligonucleotide" ISIS 405277 is an antisense oligonucleotide against Factor 2
   (prothrombin) - itself an anticoagulant target. The time-to-thrombosis comparison is therefore anticoagulant vs anticoagulant.
   The results sentence also ends in a truncated clause ("and those veins showing occlusion.").
10. US 10,772,906 Table 119: fibrinogen is measured weekly and tabulated but the patent draws no conclusion from it. The
    ISIS 416850 escalating arm falls from 310 mg/dL pre-dose to 177-190 mg/dL at days 71-85 while PBS holds at 233-246 mg/dL.
    This is an unremarked, potentially meaningful coagulation signal.
11. US 9,150,864 Table 18/19 captions say "stenosis-induced IVC thrombosis model" but the Example 11 text that generates them
    describes a thromboplastin-induced pulmonary embolism model; the same example points to a non-existent "Table 32".
12. US 9,150,864 Tables 20/21: doses are expressed as mg/kg/WEEK (10/20/40/80), twice the per-dose figures used elsewhere in the
    same patent, and the 10 mg/kg/wk arm exceeds the PBS control at most timepoints, so the dose response is not monotonic.
13. US 10,858,658 Table 22: the animal 1 / day 50 cell is printed as "38.3." with a stray trailing period; recorded verbatim.
    Example 14's text says 2 mg/kg while the FIG. 7 caption for the same experiment says 4 mg/kg. Example 13 reports one
    70%-80% aPTT range for "both animals" when the two animals received different compounds (AD01001 and AD01520); that quote is
    recorded once under each compound key and the two rows must NOT be treated as independent observations.
14. None of the three patents reports dispersion, group size or a statistical test for any coagulation table except where noted;
    almost every value in this bundle is a single pooled point estimate.

PLATELET-ENDPOINT BOUNDARY
Platelet count is a separate Challenge endpoint and no platelet-count row was extracted. Two platelet-adjacent readout families
were kept because the source ties them directly to the coagulation cascade: (a) PF-4 mRNA in an excised thrombus, used as a
thrombus-mass index and filed as thrombotic_outcome; (b) US 9,150,864 Table 20, in vivo labelled-platelet accumulation inside a
growing clot, filed as platelet_coag_crosstalk and reported from the same imaging runs as the fibrin signal in Table 21. Every
such row says so in notes.

MODIFICATIONS TABLE
Per-position rows were emitted only where the source publishes chemistry position by position. For US 10,858,658 that is a printed
per-residue notation with a stated legend (lower case = 2'-OMe, Nf = 2'-F, dN = 2'-deoxy, s = phosphorothioate, invdN = inverted,
UNA superscript = 2',3'-seco); the four dosed strands were parsed with that legend and every character of every string was
consumed. For the Ionis/Isis gapmers, the source states a complete design rule for the whole table (motif with explicit wing and
gap lengths, 2'-MOE wings, 2'-deoxy gap, all-phosphorothioate linkages, all cytidines 5-methyl) and prints the motif in each
compound's own row, which fully determines each position; those rows carry the governing design paragraph as their basis. Where a
compound's motif is not printed - ISIS 404057, ISIS 404071, ISIS 418026, ISIS 421208, ISIS 405277 - no modification rows were
emitted and the oligo chemistry fields are NOT_REPORTED, even though the patent makes a general statement about its murine
Factor 11 series. UNA positions have sugar_mod NOT_REPORTED because the schema enumeration has no UNA term; the real chemistry is
stated in the basis field of those rows. Phosphodiester calls on the Arrowhead strands are read from the absence of the legend's
's' marker and every such row says so in its basis.

ROW-KEYING CONVENTION (why three oligos carry no measurement rows)
Each measurement is keyed to exactly one oligonucleotide. For the Arrowhead RNAi duplexes the row is keyed to the ANTISENSE
strand (S8_AD01001_AS, S8_AD01520_AS) and the sense strand is registered as its own oligo with full per-position chemistry but
no rows, so a duplex measurement is never double counted; the dosed article named in every such row is the duplex plus its MLP
delivery polymer. Likewise the sense-strand antidote ISIS 418026 carries no rows of its own: the Table 35 reversal rows are keyed
to ISIS 404071 and name ISIS 418026 in delivery_method and dose_value as the second oligonucleotide of the combination. So
S8_AD01001_SS, S8_AD01520_SS and S3_ISIS418026 intentionally have zero measurements.

READOUT_UNIT VOCABULARY
Where the schema's readout_unit enumeration has no term for the unit the source actually printed, the source's unit is recorded
rather than forced into a near-match. Out-of-enumeration units used here, all taken from the source: "g" (grams of blood in the
tail-bleeding assays), "mg" (thrombus weight), "mm3" (intracerebral haemorrhage volume), "fluorescence a.u." (intravital imaging
of platelet accumulation and fibrin formation), "OD600" (Evans Blue dye leached from lung), "score (0-4)" and "score (0-5)"
(lung perfusion defect and neurologic deficit scales, both with their range as defined by the source), and
"minutes (mean +/- SD as printed)" (Example 22 thrombosis times). Downstream normalisation should map these; none was invented.

CROSS-BUNDLE LINKS
ISIS 416858 (US 10,772,906) is the compound Ionis carried forward as IONIS-FXIRx / fesomersen. That development name appears
nowhere in the patent and is recorded only as an external cross-reference in the oligo notes, never as a source claim. Its
monkey aPTT series (Table 117, rising to 1.79 by day 85) and matched Factor XI activity inhibition (Table 118, 78% by day 85)
are the preclinical anchor for any clinical FXI-ASO rows held elsewhere in the dataset.
refused_rows:
1. NON-OLIGONUCLEOTIDE COMPARATOR ARMS. Warfarin, Apixaban, LOVENOX (enoxaparin), PLAVIX (clopidogrel) and recombinant human
   Factor 7a all have their own dose-response coagulation data in US 10,772,906 (Tables 21, 22, 23, 25, 26, 27, 28, 29, 30, 31,
   32, 33, 39, 40, 41). None was written as a measurement row because this dataset keys every row to an oligonucleotide. Their
   values are preserved verbatim inside the control_value / effect_vs_control / notes fields of the matched ASO rows so the
   comparison survives without inventing oligo keys.
2. US 10,772,906 Table 42 in full (tail bleeding for PLAVIX, Apixaban and their combination). No oligonucleotide is present in any
   arm of that table, so no row could be honestly keyed to a compound in this dataset.
3. US 10,772,906 Table 121, platelet aggregation in cynomolgus monkeys measured in Ohms by impedance aggregometry after ADP
   and/or collagen. This is agonist-induced platelet FUNCTION measured ex vivo, not a coagulation-cascade readout, and the source
   does not tie it to PT/aPTT/fibrinogen; extracting it would blur the boundary with the separate platelet endpoint. The
   contrasting decision on US 9,150,864 Table 20 (kept) is explained in the extraction notes: that table measures platelet
   accumulation inside a forming thrombus in vivo, alongside fibrin, not agonist-induced aggregation.
4. All platelet-count tables (US 10,772,906 Tables 66, 137 and 158). Thrombocytopenia is a separate Challenge endpoint with its
   own dossier and none of these tables is tied by the source to a coagulation-cascade readout.
5. All non-coagulation tolerability data in the three patents - ALT, AST, bilirubin, albumin, BUN, creatinine, urine
   protein/creatinine, organ and body weights, haematocrit, haemoglobin, RBC/WBC/differential counts, reticulocytes, cytokines,
   oligonucleotide tissue concentrations and half-lives, viscosity, and all mRNA knockdown tables. These are out of endpoint scope.
   (Factor XI and Factor XII PROTEIN tables were kept, but only because both are measured by a factor-deficient-plasma
   clotting-time assay, which makes them coagulation factor-activity readouts; the mRNA tables were not kept.)
6. Any numeric value that exists only in a figure. Specifically refused: Arrowhead FIG. 5 and FIG. 6 (serum F12 with aPTT),
   FIG. 7 (aPTT versus F12 nadir under repeat dosing), FIG. 8 (subcutaneous AD02562), FIG. 10 (time to carotid occlusion) and
   FIG. 11A (bleeding times including the F7 positive control). Qualitative rows carrying the source's own sentence were written
   instead, with readout_value NOT_REPORTED.
7. Per-position modification rows for ISIS 404057, ISIS 404071, ISIS 418026, ISIS 421208 and ISIS 405277. US 10,772,906 makes a
   blanket statement that its murine Factor 11 antisense oligonucleotides are 5-10-5 MOE gapmers with a full phosphorothioate
   backbone and 5-methylcytidines, and these five compounds are almost certainly built that way, but none of them appears in
   Table 16 or any other motif-bearing table, so the design is not published against these compound numbers. Attributing 20
   positions each on that inference would have been modelling, not extraction.
8. Component strand sequences of Arrowhead duplex AD02562 and of the unnamed F7 trigger. AD02562's strand IDs (AM02967-AS /
   AM03339-SS) are recorded in its oligo row so a reviewer can retrieve them, but the strands were not transcribed because
   Example 15 publishes no aPTT result for that compound. The F7 trigger has no duplex ID or sequence anywhere in the patent.
9. A numeric aPTT value for Arrowhead Example 13. The source gives a single 70%-80% range for two animals that received two
   different compounds; the range was recorded verbatim under both compound keys with an explicit warning rather than split,
   apportioned or assigned to one compound.
10. Any severity grade. severity_stated_by_source carries only the source's own wording ("the hemorrhagic potential of the
    compounds provided herein is low", "aPTT did not exceed normal values", "severe perfusion defects", "without increased
    bleeding risk"); no grading was applied.
